description:
Winterdale, a land of bitter cold. In this small village trapped in endless winter lives Jade, a gamekeeper of unknown origins. Jade leads an isolated life, hunting reindeer—and Ilya has been nursing a one-sided crush on him for seven years. With dazzling looks and exceptional talent, Ilya is perfection itself, lacking nothing, yet Jade only ever treats him like a little kid and pushes him away...

"Hey, kid."

The darkness gave the boy a light tap.

"I don't think I'm a kid anymore."

As he answered, the boy’s frame seemed to tower suddenly. His muscles were hard and sleek, as if chiseled from a massive diamond.

"Jade, do you want to kiss me?"

From so long ago. Even before his thoughts had matured or his sense of self had fully formed, a space for Jade had already existed in a corner of Ilya’s heart.

"Jade, do you want to have sex with me?"

Like a lost child feeling his way through the dark without a lantern, Ilya wrapped his arms around the man's lower body. *(Source: RIDI, translated)*
